Results gather in ``src/spacr_watch``, and a record there lets a restarted watch skip the microscope fields of view already analysed. ``watch_normalization_pool='fixed_map'`` instead waits for the entire declared static acquisition and retains the ordinary batch recipe's shared normalization and padding.

records.source: ``watch_folder`` — keep watching ``src`` and analyse each field as its files arrive and stop changing, with ``watch_pipeline``, ``watch_measure_settings``, ``watch_settle_seconds``, ``watch_poll_seconds`` and ``watch_idle_minutes``. Results gather in ``src/spacr_watch``, and a record there lets a restarted watch skip the fields already analysed. ``watch_normalization_pool='fixed_map'`` instead waits for the entire declared static acquisition and retains the ordinary batch recipe's shared normalization and padding.
records.translation: ``watch_folder`` — fortsätt att bevaka ``src`` och analysera varje synfält när dess filer har kommit och slutat ändras, med ``watch_pipeline``, ``watch_measure_settings``, ``watch_settle_seconds``, ``watch_poll_seconds`` och ``watch_idle_minutes``. Resultaten samlas i ``src/spacr_watch``, och en post där låter en omstartad bevakning hoppa över de synfält som redan analyserats. ``watch_normalization_pool='fixed_map'`` väntar i stället på hela den deklarerade statiska insamlingen och behåller den vanliga satsbearbetningens gemensamma normalisering och utfyllnad.

records.context: A separate Mask-only route accepts a fixed Convert map with every explicitly labelled YX image layer in a dense image data channel-by-Z-by-time grid when ``z_stack`` and ``t_stack`` are both on. It builds native TZYXC archives for the existing 4-D segmenter; physical Z and frame spacing and TZYX axis order must be declared. The planar sources remain unchanged. Timelapse tracking, Measure and Classify are not enabled by this route.

records.source: A separate Mask-only route accepts a fixed Convert map with every explicitly labelled YX plane in a dense channel-by-Z-by-time grid when ``z_stack`` and ``t_stack`` are both on. It builds native TZYXC archives for the existing 4-D segmenter; physical Z and frame spacing and TZYX axis order must be declared. The planar sources remain unchanged. Timelapse tracking, Measure and Classify are not enabled by this route.
records.translation: En separat körväg för enbart Mask tar emot en fast Convert-karta med varje uttryckligen märkt YX-plan i ett fullständigt rutnät av kanaler, Z och tid när både ``z_stack`` och ``t_stack`` är på. Den bygger ursprungliga TZYXC-arkiv för den befintliga 4-D-segmenteraren; fysisk Z-distans, bildruteintervall och TZYX-axelordning måste anges. De plana källbilderna förblir oförändrade. Denna körväg aktiverar inte tidsseriespårning, Measure eller Classify.
